name: zebrafish (Danio rerio), larva at 5 days post-fertilisation
reproduces: NOT anatomy-model/zebrafish/build_larva.py (58 pieces); same note as zebrafish-adult.

standard_length_m.source: development/zebrafish/trajectory.mjs at(3 d) = 5 dpf; Parichy 2009 larval rate 0.32 mm/day from 3.4 mm at Pec-fin

body_mass_kg.source: Beaudouin 2015 fit, within its <=15 mm range

body_depth_over_SL.source: Parichy DM et al. 2009 Dev Dyn Table 3 regressions / FishBase morphometrics, via development/zebrafish/trajectory.mjs proportions()

body_width_over_SL.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

body_section_exponent.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

head_fraction_SL.source: Parichy DM et al. 2009 Dev Dyn Table 3 regressions / FishBase morphometrics, via development/zebrafish/trajectory.mjs proportions()

peduncle_depth_frac.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement; larval body tapers less

peduncle_width_frac.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

pectoral_len_over_SL.source: development/zebrafish/trajectory.mjs: at 4.2 mm SL the pectoral is a larval fin (endoskeletal disc + fin fold, NO rays) (Hale 2014; Grandel 1998; Lalonde 2018). The 0.075 extent is assumed; the ABSENCE OF RAYS is measured.

pectoral_span_over_SL.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

pectoral_area_over_SL2.source: schematic (textbook-generic teleost); not a flying-fish or zebrafish measurement

pectoral_ray_count.source: no lepidotrichia below 6.4 mm SL (Lalonde & Akimenko 2018 Fig. 8); rays appear at 6.4 mm, numbered by 6.8 mm

pelvic_len_over_SL.source: pelvic bud milestone PB is passed at 7.2 mm SL (Parichy 2009 Table 4): absent at 4.2 mm

dorsal_height_over_SL.source: median fin FOLD only; DR (dorsal ray) milestone at 6.2 mm SL (Parichy 2009)

dorsal_ray_count.source: Parichy 2009 Table 4 milestone DR not yet passed

anal_height_over_SL.source: median fin fold; AR milestone at 5.8 mm SL

caudal_upper_lobe_over_SL.source: caudal fin fold, CR milestone (caudal rays) at 4.5 mm SL; at 4.2 mm the notochord tip is only beginning to flex (FLe 4.5 mm)

caudal_ray_count.source: CR milestone not yet passed at 4.2 mm SL

vertebra_count.source: the full complement of somites is segmented by hatching; centra ossify later. Kept at 32 so the larva shares a topology with the adult.

flight_muscle_fraction.source: no girdle muscle measured; near-zero placeholder
